text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Trainer-san.
I am Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will never settle for second place.
I shall reign at the absolute pinnacle as queen."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: In order to become a guiding light for my precious little sisters――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
